specFidelityNotes: Diff origin/main..cb0a41aa implements P2.10-A5 (#529) Redis read-through cache for Analytics KPI envelopes per ADR-038. analytics_kpi_cache package provides envelope_cache_key (analytics:kpi_envelope:{shop_id}), get_analytics_kpi_envelope read-through (Redis first, Postgres SoT on miss/outage), refresh_analytics_kpi_envelope_cache fail-open after upsert, and create_redis_client factory. precompute_shop_analytics_kpis upserts Postgres then refreshes Redis via optional redis_client. Four unit tests cover hit, miss fill, precompute refresh, and Redis outage degraded Postgres read. No apps/demo, masking (#530), or public GET (#531) changes.

convention_notes.note: RedisError caught on read and refresh; Postgres rows never discarded on outage — satisfies ADR-038 degraded path.
No TTL on cache keys yet; refresh-on-precompute only. Acceptable for slice; stale reads possible if Postgres updated outside precompute.
